reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Intensified Malaria Control Program in Indonesia - Indonesia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Indonesia, Malaria, Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control, Ministry of Health of The Republic of Indonesia (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce morbidity and mortality associated with malaria by reducing malaria transmission to the lowest possible level with epidemiologically appropriate interventions. The objectives of this program are: Expand access to early, confirmed diagnosis (microscopy/RDTs) and prompt treatment with ACT among high risk population including children under 5 and pregnant women. Scale up coverage and use of LLINs among high risk population. Improve routine malaria surveillance and reporting for improved management including epidemic investigation and control so that investigation of reported epidemics is routinely initiated within 24 hours and > 90% of health facilities report on time. Through advocacy, increase support for malaria control at community, district, provincial and national level so that district and provincial contribution to malaria control are increased by the end of the grant period. Strengthen and improve malaria program management at central, provincial and district level
